title: interop B4: live one-way run mimid -> mimi-hubd
description: Start mimi-hubd with throwaway certs, drive mimid PeerClient against its TLS-PL lane (keyMaterial, submitMessage, consent, identifierQuery, reportAbuse, update with one custom proposal). Manual runbook or ignored test; not in CI. Record mismatches as beads.
notes: Haven builds root-level directory URLs as https://{provider_domain}{path} with no port (mimi-hubd/src/lib.rs directory()). Locally the harness must make provider_domain resolve to the proxy/hub (e.g. provider_domain=localhost:<port> if Haven accepts a port there, or a hosts entry); mimid uses directory URLs as given (decision .6.48).
